procedure: Arrange two glass funnels, adhesive tape, two lids, and dry sand.
Make a model of a sandclock using the two funnels and secure them with adhesive tape.
Put dry sand in the upper funnel and set the sandclock upright.
Start the stopwatch as the sand begins to flow.
At 5-second intervals, note the position of the sand surface along the straight side of the upper funnel and record the elapsed time and position.
Note the time when all the sand has flowed down completely.
Make a paper scale from the recorded sand-level observations and paste it along the straight side of the glass funnels.
aim: To make a model sandclock and use timed sand-level observations to prepare a paper time scale.

viva.question: What makes the sand flow from one funnel to the other?
Why should the sand be dry?
viva.answer: Dry sand flows more freely and consistently.

viva.question: What should you do when starting the timing?
viva.answer: Start the stopwatch as the sand begins to flow.

viva.question: What does each mark on the paper scale show?
viva.answer: The sand level corresponding to an elapsed time.

calculation: Time for complete flow = stopwatch reading when the upper funnel is empty = 20 s.

columns: Distance of sand surface from funnel junction along the upper funnel (cm)

diagram: Draw two glass funnels joined narrow-end to narrow-end with adhesive tape, showing sand in the upper funnel flowing into the lower funnel; label upper funnel, lower funnel, dry sand, direction of flow, adhesive tape, lids, paper time scale, and the scale’s straight-side position marks.
title: Model of a sandclock
precautions: Keep the sandclock upright and steady while the sand flows.
Start the stopwatch as soon as the sand begins to flow.
Record each sand-level position at the same 5-second intervals.
Use dry sand and ensure the passage between the funnels is not blocked.
Secure the funnels with tape and handle the glass carefully.
result: A paper time scale was prepared from the timed sand-level observations. In this trial, the sand flowed completely in 20 s.
